versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.0

- Initial release of guaikei·小红书爆款笔记查找
- Provides command-line retrieval of public Xiaohongshu note data, including keyword search, detailed note info, comment extraction, and creator post monitoring
- Includes decision-tree instructions for handling user input scenarios and mapping requests to commands
- Details error handling, result validation, and environment setup requirements
- Covers only public data; does not support login, posting, or private content
